title: Planning Your Finances
text: Discover how financial planning shapes life and career decisions. Learn about budgeting, salary, taxes, and saving for the future.
cdi_links: 4.B.03 Recognising the role that money and finances play in decisions about life and career

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore
bullets: How salaries affect life choices
The basics of budgeting and managing expenses
Understanding taxes, credit, and long-term savings
How financial planning supports independence and future goals

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can explain why financial planning is important
I can describe the role of salary, budgeting, and credit
I can recognise the impact of taxes and pensions
I can create a simple plan to manage personal finances

title: Key Words
bullets: Financial Planning – Organising your money over time to meet goals.
Salary – The money you earn from a job.
Credit – Borrowed money that must be repaid.
Budgeting – Tracking income and spending to control money.
Tax – Money paid to the government from earnings.
Pension – Savings set aside for retirement.

title: Quick Questions
text: Imagine you have a part-time job and earn £200 a week.
How would you spend or save this money?
What might you need to pay for immediately?
What could you save for the future?

title: Money Basics Everyone Should Know
bullets: Salary and Spending: Your salary determines what you can afford today and in the future.
Budgeting: Prioritise essentials like food, rent, transport, and bills before extras.
Credit: Borrowing money is useful but must be repaid.

title: Money Basics Everyone Should Know
bullets: Taxes: Most earnings are subject to income tax and National Insurance.
Pensions & Saving: Saving for retirement ensures you have money later in life.
Cost of Living: Be aware of expenses like rent, transport, utilities, and food.

title: Activity
text:
Your Personal Finance Plan
You will explore how money affects life choices and practice planning for real-life scenarios.

title: Key Takeaways
text: Budgeting and understanding salary, credit, and taxes helps make informed decisions
Saving early builds security for the future
